Foam padding offers comfort, but the solid hardwood frame ensures stability and support. 82"W x 37"D x 36"H Solid hardwood frame with tapered wood legs Reversible and removable back and seat cushions Contemporary style and easy-care fabric combine to make this a welcome addition to any room. No assembly required Avoid moisture. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
